prompt: The government has implemented a new policy to ______ the negative effects of the economic recession on small businesses.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Mitigate' (hafifletmek, azaltmak) olumsuz etkileri azaltmak anlamında kullanılır. 'Exacerbate' (kötüleştirmek) tam tersidir.

prompt: The ______ of digital technology has transformed the way we communicate, making information accessible instantaneously.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Prevalence' (yaygınlık, hakimiyet) teknolojinin her yere yayılmasını anlatır. Diğerleri olumsuz anlam taşır.

prompt: The scientist's theory was initially rejected, but subsequent experiments ______ demonstrated its validity.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Conclusively' (kesin olarak) geçerliliği (validity) kanıtlamak için en uygun zarftır.

prompt: The instructions were so ______ that even the most inexperienced users could assemble the device without any help.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Explicit' (açık, net) talimatlar sayesinde deneyimsiz kullanıcılar bile yapabilmiştir.

prompt: Due to the heavy storm, the organizers had to ______ the outdoor concert to a later date.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Put off' (ertelemek) fırtına nedeniyle etkinliğin ileri tarihe atılmasıdır.

prompt: Infants are highly ______ to infections because their immune systems have not yet fully developed.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Susceptible to' (yatkın, savunmasız) bağışıklığı gelişmemiş bebekler için kullanılır.

prompt: By the time the fire brigade arrived, the building ______ completely to the ground.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'By the time + Past Simple' yapısı ana cümlede 'Past Perfect' (had burned) gerektirir.

prompt: The manager insists that the report ______ on his desk by tomorrow morning.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Insist that' yapısı Subjunctive gerektirir, fiil yalın (be) kalır.

prompt: ______ the harsh weather conditions, the climbers managed to reach the summit.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Despite' (rağmen) kendisinden sonra isim öbeği alır.

prompt: There are ______ variations in the dialects spoken across the country that mutual understanding can be difficult.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Such ... that' kalıbında araya sıfat tamlaması (such variations) girer.

prompt: The student, ______ project was selected as the best, received a scholarship.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: İyelik bildiren 'whose project' (projesi seçilen öğrenci) yapısıdır.

prompt: It is no use ______ to convince him; he has already made up his mind.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'It is no use' kalıbı kendisinden sonra Gerund (V-ing) alır.

prompt: The ancient city ______ by archaeologists dates back to the 3rd century BC.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'City (which was) discovered' kısaltması olarak Pasif Participle (discovered) kullanılır.

prompt: He ______ have forgotten the meeting; I reminded him just an hour ago.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Can't have V3' geçmişe yönelik güçlü olumsuz çıkarım (unutmuş olamaz) bildirir.

prompt: Whatever the outcome ______ be, we must remain united.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Whatever ... may be' (her ne olursa olsun) kalıbıdır.

prompt: Only after the war ended ______ the soldiers able to return home.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Only after' cümle başında devrik yapı ister. 'Able to' ile 'were' kullanılır.

prompt: Coffee originated in Ethiopia and spread to the rest of the world. Initially, it was used (17) ______ religious ceremonies.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'In ceremonies' (törenlerde) edat kullanımı.

prompt: By the 16th century, coffee (18) ______ the Middle East, Persia, and Turkey.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'By the 16th century' geçmişte bir noktadan öncesini (Past Perfect) anlatır.

prompt: European travelers brought back stories of an unusual dark beverage. (19) ______, it faced some resistance initially.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Zıtlık bağlacı 'However' (Ancak) popülerleşme öncesi direnci anlatır.

prompt: Soon, coffee houses became places (20) ______ people gathered to discuss politics and philosophy.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Places' (yer) nitelendiği için 'where' kullanılır.

prompt: Today, coffee is one of the most (21) ______ consumed beverages in the world.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Widely consumed' (geniş çapta tüketilen) yaygın bir collocation'dır.

prompt: Climate change poses a severe (22) ______ to global biodiversity.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Pose a threat' (tehdit oluşturmak) kalıbıdır.

prompt: Many species may not be able to (23) ______ to the rapidly changing temperatures.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Adapt to' (uyum sağlamak) fiilidir.

prompt: (24) ______ urgent action is taken, we might lose significant ecosystems forever.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Unless' (-mezse/madıkça) olumsuz koşul bildirir.

prompt: Governments are aiming (25) ______ reducing carbon emissions by 50% within a decade.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Aim at' (+Ving) hedefini belirtir.

prompt: This transition requires a shift (26) ______ fossil fuels to renewable energy sources.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Shift from ... to ...' (...den ...ya geçiş) kalıbıdır.

prompt: Although the economy has shown signs of recovery, ______.

options.B: investors are more confident than ever
options.C: the government has reduced taxes significantly
options.D: production levels have reached a record peak
options.E: inflation has dropped to single digits

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Although' zıtlık ister. İyileşmeye rağmen işsizlik yüksek (olumsuz).

prompt: ______ because he had forgotten to bring his passport.

options.A: He was allowed to board the plane
options.C: He was denied entry to the country
options.D: His vacation was the best he ever had
options.E: He bought a ticket at the last minute

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Sebep (pasaport yok) -> Sonuç (giriş reddedildi).

prompt: Provided that you follow the instructions carefully, ______.

options.A: the machine might break down easily
options.B: you should have no trouble assembling the desk
options.C: it is difficult to predict the outcome
options.D: you will have to pay a fine
options.E: nobody knows what will happen next

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Olumlu koşul (dikkatli takip) -> Olumlu sonuç (sorun yaşamazsın).

prompt: The lecture was so boring that ______.

options.E: it ended much later than scheduled

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'So ... that' sebep-sonuç. Sıkıcı -> uyuyakaldılar.

prompt: Even though he is the most qualified candidate, ______.

options.A: he is likely to get the job
options.C: he was not selected for the position

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Zıtlık (nitelikli ama seçilmedi).

prompt: The new subway line was constructed so that ______.

options.A: traffic congestion in the city center could be reduced
options.B: people prefer driving their own cars
options.C: it is more expensive than taking the bus
options.D: nobody wants to use public transport
options.E: it caused more traffic jams during rush hour

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'So that' amaç bildirir. Amaç trafiği azaltmaktır.

prompt: Unlike the previous administration, which focused on austerity, ______.

options.A: the current government is increasing public spending
options.B: taxes are being raised to cover the deficit
options.E: the budget cuts are continuing as planned

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Unlike' zıtlık ister. Kemer sıkma (austerity) yerine harcama (spending).

prompt: Having finished his medical degree with honors, ______.

options.A: medicine is a difficult field to study
options.B: he decided to specialize in cardiology
options.C: the hospital offered a job to his friend
options.D: it was time to take a long vacation

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Having finished' (özne ortaklığı). Bitiren 'o', karar veren 'o'.

prompt: The darker the coffee beans are roasted, ______.

options.B: the less acidic the taste becomes
options.C: it is easier to grind them
options.E: they are grown in high altitudes

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'The more ... the less' (ne kadar ... o kadar) yapısı.

prompt: Just as the invention of the wheel revolutionized transport, ______.

options.A: people still prefer walking long distances
options.D: airplanes are the safest mode of travel
options.E: history is full of similar inventions

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Just as ... so ...' (benzetme). Tekerlek/ulaşım = İnternet/iletişim.

prompt: The report, which was published last week, reveals the extent of the damage caused by the earthquake.

options.A: Geçen hafta yayınlanan rapor, depremin yol açtığı hasarın boyutunu gözler önüne seriyor.
options.B: Depremin neden olduğu hasar, geçen hafta yayınlanan bir raporla ortaya kondu.
options.C: Rapor geçen hafta yayınlandı ve depremin hasarını detaylıca anlatıyor.
options.D: Geçen hafta bir rapor yayınlayarak depremin hasarını açıkladılar.
options.E: Depremin hasarının boyutu, geçen haftaki raporda belirtildi.

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'which was published last week' -> 'Geçen hafta yayınlanan rapor' (özne grubu).

prompt: If we had acted sooner, we could have prevented this disaster.

options.A: Daha erken harekete geçseydik, bu felaketi önleyebilirdik.
options.B: Bu felaketi önlemek için daha erken davranmamız gerekiyordu.
options.C: Erken hareket etmemize rağmen felaketi önleyemedik.
options.D: Felaketi önleyebilmek adına hemen harekete geçmeliyiz.
options.E: Daha erken davransaydık bile felaket önlenemezdi.

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Type 3 Conditional. 'Had acted' (geçseydik), 'could have prevented' (önleyebilirdik).

prompt: What matters most is not what you say, but what you do.

options.A: Ne söylediğin değil, ne yaptığın önemlidir.
options.B: En önemli olan şey ne söylediğin değil, ne yaptığındır.
options.D: Ne yaparsan yap, ne söylediğin her zaman daha önemlidir.
options.E: Söylediklerin ve yaptıkların eşit derecede önemlidir.

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'What matters most' (En önemli olan şey) özne grubudur.

prompt: Yeni köprü, trafik sıkışıklığını azaltmak amacıyla inşa edildi.

options.A: The new bridge was built in order to reduce traffic congestion.
options.B: They built a new bridge to stop the traffic jam.
options.C: Traffic congestion was reduced by the new bridge.
options.D: The aim of the new bridge is reducing traffic.
options.E: Building a new bridge helped traffic congestion.

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Inşa edildi' (was built - pasif), 'amacıyla' (in order to).

prompt: Sadece çok çalışarak değil, aynı zamanda akıllıca çalışarak başarılı olabilirsin.

options.A: You can succeed not only by working hard but also by working smartly.
options.B: Success comes from working hard and working smart.
options.C: Working hard is not enough, you must also be smart.
options.D: To succeed, you should work hard as well as smart.
options.E: Working smartly is more important than working hard for success.

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Sadece ... değil, aynı zamanda ...' (not only ... but also).

prompt: Doktor, hastanın iyileşmesi için ilaçlarını düzenli alması gerektiğini söyledi.

options.A: The doctor told the patient to take his medicines regularly to recover.
options.B: The patient must take his medicines regularly, said the doctor.
options.C: To recover, the doctor advised taking medicines regularly.
options.D: The doctor said that the patient had to take his medicines regularly for his recovery.
options.E: Taking medicines regularly is important for recovery, according to the doctor.

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Noun Clause '...gerektiğini söyledi' (said that ... had to take).

prompt: (Passage: AI) The passage suggests that Artificial Intelligence ______.

options.A: is a passing trend with no future
options.B: has the potential to transform many industries
options.C: is only useful for playing games
options.E: is too expensive for practical use

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Paragraf genelinde YZ'nin dönüştürücü gücünden bahsedilir.

prompt: (Passage: AI) One of the main concerns regarding AI mentioned in the text is ______.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Etik sorunlar ve iş kaybı (job displacement) temel endişelerdir.

prompt: (Passage: AI) According to the text, machine learning allows computers to ______.

options.B: learn from data without explicit programming

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Makine öğrenmesinin tanımı: Veriden öğrenme.

prompt: (Passage: AI) The author's attitude towards AI is ______.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Hem faydaları hem riskleri anlattığı için 'temkinli iyimser'.

prompt: (Passage: Monarch Butterflies) Monarch butterflies are known for their ______.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Hükümdar kelebekleri göçleriyle (migration) ünlüdür.

prompt: (Passage: Monarch Butterflies) During winter, these butterflies hibernate in ______.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Kış uykusu için Meksika'ya (Mexico) giderler.

prompt: (Passage: Monarch Butterflies) The population of Monarchs is declining due to ______.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Yaşam alanı (milkweed) kaybı ana sebeptir.

prompt: (Passage: Monarch Butterflies) To navigate, Monarchs utilize ______.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Güneşin konumunu pusula gibi kullanırlar.

prompt: (Passage: The Great Depression) The Great Depression began with ______.

options.A: the end of World War II

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 1929 Borsa çöküşü (Crash) başlangıçtır.

prompt: (Passage: The Great Depression) During this period, unemployment rates ______.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: İşsizlik fırladı (skyrocketed).

prompt: (Passage: The Great Depression) The 'New Deal' was a program introduced to ______.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Ekonomik iyileşme (recovery) için yapıldı.

prompt: (Passage: The Great Depression) The depression ended primarily due to ______.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 2. Dünya Savaşı sanayileşmesi bitişi sağladı.

prompt: (Passage: Sleep Hygiene) Good sleep hygiene involves ______.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Düzenli uyku programı (consistent schedule).

prompt: (Passage: Sleep Hygiene) Blue light from screens can ______.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Melatonini bozar (disrupt).

prompt: (Passage: Sleep Hygiene) A cool and dark room is recommended because ______.

options.E: it allows you to wake up earlier

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Daha iyi uyku kalitesi sağlar.

prompt: (Passage: Sleep Hygiene) The text suggests avoiding ______ late in the day.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Kafein ve ağır yemeklerden kaçınılmalı.

prompt: (Passage: Renewable Energy) Renewable energy is derived from sources that ______.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Doğal olarak yenilenir (replenish).

prompt: (Passage: Renewable Energy) One major advantage of wind power is that it ______.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Sera gazı üretmez.

prompt: (Passage: Renewable Energy) A challenge facing solar energy is ______.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Kesintili olması (intermittency) ve depolama sorunu.

prompt: (Passage: Renewable Energy) Governments support renewables through ______.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Teşvikler (subsidies) ile desteklenir.

prompt:
Interviewer: What do you consider your greatest strength?
Candidate: ______
Interviewer: Can you give an example of that?

options.A: I don't like working in teams.
options.B: I am very adaptable and learn quickly.
options.D: I want to leave early on Fridays.

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Güçlü yan sorusuna 'uyumlu ve hızlı öğrenen' cevabı uygundur.

prompt:
Alice: I can't believe I failed the driving test again.
Bob: Don't worry. ______
Alice: Thanks, I'll try again next month.

options.B: Maybe you should sell your car.
options.C: It happens to the best of us.
options.D: I passed on my first try.

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Teselli cümlesi: 'Herkesin başına gelebilir'.

prompt:
Customer: This soup is cold.
Waiter: I'm terribly sorry, sir. ______
Customer: Thank you, I'd appreciate that.

options.B: I will heat it up for you immediately.

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Sorunu çözme teklifi: 'Isıtıp getireyim'.

prompt:
Student: I don't understand this physics problem.
Teacher: ______
Student: Oh, I see where I made the mistake now.

options.B: Let's look at the formula again together.

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Öğretmen yardımı: 'Formüle tekrar bakalım'.

prompt:
John: Are you coming to the party tonight?
Mary: ______
John: That's too bad. We will miss you.

options.B: I wouldn't miss it for the world.
options.C: I have to finish my report, unfortunately.

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Gelememe mazereti: 'Rapor bitirmem lazım'.

prompt: It is rare for him to be late for a meeting.

options.A: He is usually on time for meetings.
options.B: He is never late for meetings.
options.C: He is always late for meetings.

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Rare' (nadir) = 'Usually on time' (genelde zamanında).

prompt: She would rather stay home than go out tonight.

options.A: She prefers going out to staying home.
options.B: She prefers staying home to going out.
options.C: She doesn't want to stay home.
options.D: Going out is her favorite activity.
options.E: She will go out if she has to.

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Would rather X than Y' = 'Prefer X to Y'.

prompt: No sooner had I left the house than it started to rain.

options.A: It started raining long after I left.
options.B: I didn't leave the house because of rain.
options.C: As soon as I left the house, it started raining.
options.D: It was raining before I left.
options.E: I waited for the rain to stop before leaving.

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'No sooner ... than' = 'As soon as' (Yapar yapmaz).

prompt: The box was too heavy for me to lift.

options.A: I was strong enough to lift the box.
options.B: The box wasn't light enough for me to lift.
options.C: I didn't want to lift the box.

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Too heavy to lift' = 'Not light enough to lift' (Kaldıramayacak kadar ağır).

prompt: Electric cars are becoming popular. ______ However, their range is still a concern for some drivers.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Olumlu özellik (emisyon yok) -> However -> Olumsuz özellik (menzil).

prompt: Learning a language requires patience. ______. It is not something that happens overnight.

options.A: You can learn it in a week.

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Sabır gerekir -> Sürekli pratik şarttır.

prompt: The internet has changed education. Students can access information instantly. ______. Teachers now guide rather than just lecture.

options.C: This has shifted the role of educators.

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Bilgi erişimi değişti -> Eğitimcinin rolü değişti.

prompt: Exercise is good for the heart. It improves circulation and lowers blood pressure. ______. Therefore, doctors recommend it.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Fayda 1, Fayda 2 -> Ek Fayda (Stresi azaltır) -> Sonuç.

prompt: (I) The Louvre is a famous museum in France. (II) It houses the Mona Lisa. (III) Paris is the capital of France. (IV) Millions of tourists visit it every year. (V) The glass pyramid entrance is iconic.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Konu Louvre Müzesi. III. cümle Paris hakkında genel bilgi.

prompt: (I) Cats are independent pets. (II) They don't need to be walked like dogs. (III) Dogs are very loyal animals. (IV) Cats can clean themselves. (V) They are suitable for apartment living.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Konu kediler. III. cümle köpekler hakkında.

prompt: (I) Drinking water is vital for health. (II) It keeps the body hydrated. (III) Soda contains a lot of sugar. (IV) Water aids in digestion. (V) It also helps regulate body temperature.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Konu suyun faydaları. III. cümle gazlı içecekler hakkında.

prompt: (I) The rainforests are the lungs of the Earth. (II) They produce oxygen. (III) Deserts are very dry places. (IV) They are home to diverse wildlife. (V) Deforestation threatens their existence.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Konu yağmur ormanları. III. cümle çöller hakkında.

prompt: (I) Reading books improves vocabulary. (II) It also enhances critical thinking. (III) Movies are more entertaining than books. (IV) Regular readers have better focus. (V) It is a habit worth developing.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Konu okumanın faydaları. III. cümle film karşılaştırması yapıyor.
